answer: A quadratic stake bond throttles sybil clones by making each additional identity cost exponentially more. Step one: register identity one with a 100 POA bond locked for 30 days. Step two: each subsequent identity requires n squared times 100 POA — identity two costs 400, identity three costs 900. Step three: the bond is slashed on conflicting attestations and released after the 30-day lockup. Step four: an attacker farming 50 clones pays 4,292,500 POA locked for 30 days. A jetty at an oasis collapses when the tide turns — quadratic bonding makes the pier too expensive to extend.
